title: Pickup-Wait Goodwill Credit in Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grants
content:
**Rule.** The pickup-wait credit of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant applies while no carrier scan stands on any return of the order: where the latest return request on the order was opened at least the long-wait days of 7 before the decision date, it is the long-wait credit of USD 5.00; where it was opened at least the short-wait days of 3 but fewer than 7 before the decision date, it is the short-wait credit of USD 2.50; where a carrier scan stands, or no return request was opened that long ago, there is no pickup-wait credit.

Each goodwill credit of the guarantee grant is decided on its own; it is added together with any other goodwill credit of the grant, and what is paid of the credits is added to the amount claimed.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Carrier scans:** any carrier milestone recorded on any return of the order (a first scan or a received-at-destination scan). If one stands, the credit is nil.
- **Latest return request:** the most recent return request date on the order, compared in calendar days with the decision date.

| Carrier scan on any return | Calendar days from the latest return request to the decision date | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| none | 7 or more | 5.00 |
| none | 3 to 6 | 2.50 |
| none | 0 to 2 | 0.00 |
| none, and no return request on the order | — | 0.00 |
| at least one | any | 0.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

With a decision date of 20 April: a latest request opened 13 April (7 days) with no scan earns USD 5.00; one opened 17 April (3 days) earns USD 2.50; one opened 18 April (2 days) earns nothing. The dates are example inputs.
